name: OpenSurvey Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted survey platform with visual form builder, conditional logic, response analytics, teams and RBAC; no vendor-enforced seats or paid feature tiers in the open-source distribution.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires PostgreSQL, Redis and application compute; infrastructure, storage and outbound email delivery are not free. Small/new upstream project; assess security and production readiness independently.
